slices.focus: Nathaniel discovers an online archive of vintage Columbus bus timetables and route maps, developing a relaxed collector hobby.
slices.summary: A younger planner shows Nathaniel an online archive of old Columbus bus timetables. He becomes engrossed in collecting PDFs of vintage route maps and schedule booklets, organizing them by decade and route family. The hobby satisfies his analytical instincts without operational pressure.
